title: Abhinandena
text: 2 Yo bhikkhave rūpe abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo sadde || gandhe || rase || phoṭṭhabbe || dhamme abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || [page 014] 14 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 20. 3 3 Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpe nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo sadde || gandhe || rase || phoṭṭhabbe || dhamme nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmī ti || ||
